facts: Aurélien Lac and Tony Wu published 'NeoMME: A Single-Tower Multimodal-Native Multilingual Foundation Encoder for Efficient Fine-Tuning and Inference' on arXiv on August 31, 2026 (arXiv:2609.01657).
NeoMME provides 260M and 800M-parameter multimodal, multilingual foundation encoders combining multilingual text and raw image patches in a single bidirectional Transformer.
Both NeoMME models are pretrained from scratch using a masked discrete-diffusion text objective conditioned on visible image patches.
The models feature a 16,384-token context window capable of encoding up to two standard 4K UHD images.
On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, NeoMME-Retriever 260M scores 0.523 nDCG@10 (surpassing all evaluated models under 800M parameters), while NeoMME-Retriever 800M reaches 0.556 nDCG@10.
On an NVIDIA L40S GPU at a 2048x2048 input size, NeoMME-260M encodes document pages at roughly twice the throughput of ColModernVBERT.
Using hierarchical token pooling and asymmetric quantization, late-interaction document embeddings can be compressed 255x while maintaining over 95% of baseline nDCG@10.
Pretrained backbones and retrieval checkpoints are contributed to Hugging Face Transformers under an Apache 2.0 license at https://hf.co/collections/Hcompany/neomme.
